prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If the object is visible, move to it and take it. Check its properties. Otherwise move forward, complete specific task. list of available nodes: <Action ID = MoveToObject    /> <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <Action ID = MoveForward    /> <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectGraspable    /> <Condition ID = IsPathClear    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectVisible? THEN
			DO MoveToObject
	ELSE
			IF IsObjectGraspable? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectProperties
	END
